Blood Test Reports are medical reports which provide the outcome of tests carried out on a blood sample. What a pelvic ultrasound actually checks

People assume a pelvic ultrasound is only for pregnancy. That's probably the most common thing patients mention when they arrive for one. But a pelvic scan covers a lot more than fetal monitoring, including ovarian cysts, uterine fibroids, endometrial thickness and bladder wall changes, most of which have no obvious symptoms early on.

At a Diagnostic Center in Goregaon, a pelvic ultrasound is done transabdominally, sometimes transvaginally depending on what the doctor wants to see. Each approach shows different layers of the same anatomy. The scan usually takes 15 to 25 minutes and uses no radiation.

Dr. Pallavi's center is in Goregaon, easy to reach from the Western Express Highway side. If your gynaecologist mentioned irregular cycles, pelvic discomfort or just a routine check, calling ahead helps you understand which type of scan to prep for.

What a mammogram can miss

Soft tissue changes, like a small thyroid nodule, a pelvic cyst or a thickening that showed up on a clinical exam, don't always give you symptoms early. By the time something feels off, the finding has often been there a while.

At a Sonography Center in Goregaon, a targeted ultrasound of the thyroid, pelvis or soft tissue can pick up changes that routine checkups or a plain X-ray won't show. The scan uses sound waves, no radiation, and usually wraps up in 20 to 25 minutes depending on the area.

Dr. Pallavi's center is in Goregaon, easy to reach from the Western Express Highway side. If your doctor flagged something vague in a recent exam and suggested imaging, calling ahead helps you get the right scan booked the first time.

What mammograms miss sometimes

A mammogram is the standard recommendation for breast screening, and it does its job well. But dense breast tissue, which is common in younger women and not rare in older ones, can make mammogram images harder to read. Dense tissue shows up white on a mammogram. So do many abnormalities. That overlap is a real clinical limitation.

Sonomammography at a Diagnostic Center in Goregaon works alongside mammography, not against it. Ultrasound reads through dense tissue differently, picking up cysts, solid nodules or subtle changes that a mammogram might underread. It uses sound waves, no radiation, and takes around 15 to 20 minutes.

Dr. Pallavi's center is in Goregaon, easy to reach from the Western Express Highway side. If your doctor mentioned dense tissue in a past report or suggested adding an ultrasound to your breast screening, call and ask about getting both done here.

What an NT scan actually measures

Between 11 and 14 weeks, there's a small window where one specific measurement can tell you a lot. The fluid at the back of a baby's neck, called nuchal translucency, is something most parents hear mentioned at their first scan appointment but don't fully understand until after.

At a Sonography Center in Goregaon, an NT scan does more than take that measurement. It checks crown-rump length, confirms the heartbeat and, when combined with a blood test, gives a clearer risk picture for chromosomal conditions. Timing matters here. Outside that 11 to 14 week window, the measurement loses accuracy.

Dr. Pallavi's center is in Goregaon, close to the Western Express Highway side. If your doctor has mentioned getting this done and you're not sure when exactly to book it, call and they'll help you plan around your dates.

What a kidney scan actually shows

Most people book an abdominal scan only when the pain gets bad enough to ignore. But a lot of what an abdominal ultrasound finds, like early kidney stones, mild fatty liver changes, or a slightly enlarged spleen, shows up well before any obvious discomfort starts.

At a Sonography Center in Goregaon, an abdominal scan typically covers the liver, kidneys, gallbladder, spleen and pancreas in one session. No radiation involved. The whole thing usually takes around 20 to 30 minutes. And the report reads the same tissue detail whether you came in with pain or just came in to check.

What a Doppler scan actually checks

You've had an ultrasound before. But when a doctor writes 'Doppler' on the referral instead of just 'USG', that's asking a different question. A regular ultrasound shows structure. A Doppler measures blood flow, how fast it's moving, which direction and whether anything is slowing it down or blocking it.

That distinction matters a lot. As a radiologist in Goregaon, Dr. Pallavi reads Doppler studies for things like blood flow to the placenta during pregnancy, carotid artery checks, or vascular changes in the legs. The scan itself uses the same sound waves as a standard ultrasound, no radiation, no injections in most cases.

The center is in Goregaon, off the Western Express Highway side. If your referral says Doppler and you're not sure how to prep or which type your doctor ordered, call before you come in.

What an X-ray won't show you

A lot of people assume an X-ray is enough if something feels off, a dull ache, some swelling, a lump that wasn't there last month. It shows bone well. But soft tissue, organ walls, gland changes? Those don't show up clearly on a plain X-ray at all.

At the Diagnostic Center in Goregaon, an abdominal or pelvic ultrasound can pick up what an X-ray misses: cysts, gallstones, kidney changes, enlarged lymph nodes. No radiation involved either. The scan usually takes around 20 to 30 minutes depending on the area being checked.

A 2D scan does its job well. It measures, checks position, flags what needs flagging. But when a parent asks 'can I see the face?' or the doctor wants a clearer look at a structural detail, that's where higher-mode imaging earns its place.

At any reliable Sonography Center in Goregaon, the difference between 2D and 4D isn't just about the image looking better. A 4D scan shows real-time movement. You see the baby yawn, stretch or turn. Clinically, it helps with soft tissue detail that a flat cross-section sometimes misses.

I was bracing myself for discomfort, but your team made it quick, gentle, and completely painless. Your expertise and caring approach put me right at ease—thank you for making health checks feel this effortless. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Sonam Khedkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful experience at Shubham Diagnostics. Dr. Jenny Chiniwala is an absolutely amazing doctor—very polite, sweet, and extremely professional. She creates a safe and comfortable environment and explains every detail with so much patience and clarity. Her calm nature truly eases all anxiety.

The staff is excellent, cooperative, and very supportive throughout the process. The center is clean, hygienic, and well-managed, which adds to the overall positive experience.

A special thanks to Ms. Rahila for her constant help with appointments, reminders, and queries—she is always approachable and kind.

Truly a trustworthy place with great service. Highly recommended! One of the BEST diagnostic centre in Mumbai I came across.

featured_reviews.name: JYOTI SINGH
featured_reviews.review_text: Very polite staff. Pranita was very good. Thanks to her I could do my mammography without any pain  and very comfortably. Dr. Jenny was so good and soft spoken. Made me understand the procedure calmly and disperse all my fears. Thanks to the entire team...Jyoti Singh

featured_reviews.name: Kuhelee Khandelwal
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited Shubham Diagnostic Centre for the first time for a pelvic scan and breast sonography, and Dr Jenny’s persona and gentle approach quickly eased my apprehension and made me comfortable. Her examinations were unhurried and she took the time to ask me questions, listen to my answers, and answer the questions I asked her. I will definitely consult her again the next time I need such tests.

featured_reviews.name: Ruchita Budhrani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to thank Dr. Jenny Chiniwala and the whole team at Shubham diagnostic centre for being extremely thoughtful and helpful throughout my pregnancy journey.
The staff is friendly , cheerful and super encouraging which really helps during the tough days and when things don't go your way.
There was never a day when I thought I was being treated like a patient but very much like a family member.
Thank you once again. God bless!

featured_reviews.name: Shenaz Pradhan
featured_reviews.review_text: I came here for the first time as I was not getting an appointment at Suburban Diagnostics. Really impressed with the service. The staff is very pleasant and helpful. Good hygiene is maintained in the place. The doctor is also very very sweet. Good bye to Suburban as I will be coming here from now on 😊

featured_reviews.review_text:
Very good ambience
Very good,humble and kind Doctor and staff
Thank You Doctor Jenny
Thank You Shubham Diagnostic Center Staff...Rahila,Sunita,Pranita,Yamini,Vilas and Bimlesh

featured_reviews.review_text: Aarthi Scan Labs, Goregaon is one of the best labs in Mumbai. I had a very good experience with proper follow-up throughout. The doctors are excellent, the staff is very supportive, and the reception guy was especially helpful and courteous. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Nurani Mani Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text: Male staff awareness level n approach towards patient should be improved. Overall it was nice experience. Reports reliability can be reconfirmed after few more attempts over a period of time. Costing undoubtedly reasonable due to no referal commission to doctors, thats what they claim.  If quality is good i will do the tests again

featured_reviews.name: Muddassir Charoliya
featured_reviews.review_text:
‼️🚨 Extremely disturbing experience. While collecting a CT scan report, the receptionist displayed aggressive and abusive behavior, escalating into a physical altercation with patients. This is completely unacceptable in a healthcare setting where basic respect and safety should be guaranteed.

What’s more concerning is that when the incident was being recorded, another staff member intervened only to remove him from view, rather than address the misconduct—raising serious concerns about accountability and management. Such behavior severely damages patient trust and reflects poorly on the facility’s standards. Neve ever recommend to anyone 👎🏻

featured_reviews.name: Adarsh
featured_reviews.review_text: The lab are well maintained, clean, and nice. By minimum cost we can do our test. Washroom are also clean, chair are maintained properly. I suggest to visit and try once you will definitely like it

featured_reviews.name: akshay rathi
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an amazing experience at the centre. I went for my mother’s blood tests and CT scan. The staff is very friendly, knowledgeable and well trained. Rates are very reasonable compared to others. Overall,  a good place to consider for your medical test needs.

featured_reviews.name: Nischal Raaj Saini
featured_reviews.review_text: I liked the motto they have added on reception. Diagnoses should not make a patient poor. Keep up the good work. The pricing they have for Mumbai is really unexpected and immediately I got the number on same day. No waiting for appointments.

featured_reviews.name: pritika jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text: Worth it👍Everything for my MRI was explained before doing scanning. Neat and clean 👍 It says no need to burn your pocket for saving your life and that’s true .Thank you for having such a great thought and vision.

featured_reviews.name: Shobhinii Bhowal
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been to many diagnostic labs but undoubtedly this has been the best so far. They have maintained hygeine, cleanliness. I had my ct scan whole abdomen and the process was so smooth. The best part was that even the reports were provided before the ascribed time. I shall recommend this lab to each and everyone for not only their cleanliness but also for their punctuality. Even the behaviour of the entire staff was good.
